displayDescription: A rubber-hose light bulb crouches, throws cords to four sockets on a dark hatched night stage, lights up and waves.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (procedural rubber-hose character, cords, sockets, iris, cached hatching)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline (single owner of composition time; pose schedule and keyed tracks evaluated as pure functions of time)
limitations: Motion (motion.dev) was not used: GSAP alone owns time to keep seeking deterministic; pose interpolation is custom code
Two-ink monochrome is preserved; the night stage swaps ink/paper roles outside the iris rather than adding hues
Cooper Black is not guaranteed locally; Georgia bold is the fallback typeface
Procedural vector drawing approximates hand-inked 1930s cel animation; no line boil or film grain
BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json had no matched sources, so no source-frame evidence informed the palette
Blender was not used, as instructed
